steps.step: API and chat tool can create and run an experiment with at least two cells that differ by one deck patch or one StrategySpec overlay, same seed and games cap, with custom queries; response includes per-cell win rate and query rates.
steps.evidence: POST /api/lab/experiments created 94e245ee-5bd9-4839-8c4a-7861814fff37 ('gate two-cell overlay vs shock'). Two cells, seed 20260831, 6 games, query cubone_play; strategy_a thrifty vs carnival overlay. POST /run returned both cells win_rate_a=1.0 and queries.cubone_play=0.5. Chat tool run_lab as admin viewer returned the same two cells.

steps.step: Lab tab at http://127.0.0.1:8000 shows the matrix for that experiment, not only a single simulation row.
steps.evidence: Lab copy: 'Experiments compare several cells at one seed.' #labList lists 'gate two-cell overlay vs shock' with '2 cells · matrix ready' and Open matrix (Fight runs listed separately in #labSims). After Open matrix, #labDetail table: shock thrifty vs shock 100.0% cubone_play 50.0%; carnival carnival vs shock 100.0% cubone_play 50.0%; Seed 20260831 · 6 games; Run cells. Human should still glance at the matrix vs Fight-run list.

steps.evidence: Second registered user GET /api/lab/experiments/94e245ee-5bd9-4839-8c4a-7861814fff37 and POST .../run both returned 404.

steps.evidence: git status --porcelain for app/, tests/, data/lab/, and .env was empty after create, run, chat tool, overlay simulate, and Lab tab open.
